children: Solana ecosystem meme coin GOLD fell more than 90% in a short period. According to Odaily, one user who bought GOLD at a high price lost about $62,100 within seven minutes.
The realtrumpcoins account, which has drawn attention from U.S. President Donald Trump, previously launched the GOLD token, and the team holds about 82.45% of the token supply.

title: Solana Meme Coin GOLD Falls More Than 90% in Minutes
